{
  "analysis_grain": "q1:产品品类粒度差评订单数TOP10; q2:产品品类粒度差评率TOP10",
  "used_tables": [
    "orders",
    "order_items",
    "order_reviews",
    "products",
    "product_category_name_translation"
  ],
  "query_sqls": [
    "SELECT COALESCE(`t`.`product_category_name_english`, `p`.`product_category_name`) AS `product_category_english`, COUNT(DISTINCT `r`.`order_id`) AS `bad_review_count` FROM `order_reviews` `r` INNER JOIN `orders` `o` ON `r`.`order_id` = `o`.`order_id` INNER JOIN `order_items` `oi` ON `o`.`order_id` = `oi`.`order_id` INNER JOIN `products` `p` ON `oi`.`product_id` = `p`.`product_id` LEFT JOIN `product_category_name_translation` `t` ON `p`.`product_category_name` = `t`.`product_category_name` WHERE `r`.`review_score` <= 2 GROUP BY `product_category_english` ORDER BY `bad_review_count` DESC LIMIT 10",
    "SELECT `sub`.`product_category_english`, `sub`.`bad_review_count` / NULLIF(`sub`.`total_orders`, 0) AS `bad_review_rate` FROM (SELECT COALESCE(`t`.`product_category_name_english`, `p`.`product_category_name`) AS `product_category_english`, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN `r`.`review_score` <= 2 THEN `r`.`order_id` END) AS `bad_review_count`, COUNT(DISTINCT `r`.`order_id`) AS `total_orders` FROM `order_reviews` `r` INNER JOIN `orders` `o` ON `r`.`order_id` = `o`.`order_id` INNER JOIN `order_items` `oi` ON `o`.`order_id` = `oi`.`order_id` INNER JOIN `products` `p` ON `oi`.`product_id` = `p`.`product_id` LEFT JOIN `product_category_name_translation` `t` ON `p`.`product_category_name` = `t`.`product_category_name` GROUP BY `product_category_english`) `sub` ORDER BY `bad_review_rate` DESC LIMIT 10"
  ],
  "result_explanation": "未命中预聚合视图（缺按品类+差评的维度组合），回退原始表生成2条SQL。q1：统计各品类下评分≤2的差评订单数，取TOP10，含运费GMV口径不涉及；品类名优先取英文映射，缺失时用葡语品名。q2：各品类差评率 = 差评订单数 / 该品类总订单数（基于有评论的订单），取TOP10，使用NULLIF防除零。均使用DISTINCT order_id避免同一订单多商品重复计数。"
}
